{{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=The like Catholike and vulgar tran{{ls}}lations in many coūtries, {{ls}}ince Luthers time.}} Now {{ls}}ince Luthers reuolt al{{ls}}o, diuers learned Catholikes, for the more {{ls}}peedy aboli{{ls}}hing of a number of fal{{ls}}e and impious tran{{ls}}lations put forth by {{ls}}undry {{ls}}ectes, and for the better pre{{ls}}eruation or reclaime of many good {{ls}}oules endangered thereby, haue publi{{ls}}hed the Bible in the {{ls}}eueral languages of almo{{ls}}t all the principal prouinces of the Latin Church: no other bookes in the world being {{ls}}o pernicious as hereticall tran{{ls}}lations of the Scriptures, poi{{ls}}oning the people vnder colour of diuine authoritie, & not many other remedies<noinclude>{{continues|being|}}</noinclude>
